commonPrompt:
Create clean wordless fitness-science teaching illustrations in the style of Ranking of Kings. Only recognizable male Bojji and Despa may appear: Bojji is one short boy with black hair, a tiny golden three-point crown, cobalt-blue tunic, white pants and black boots; never a tall adult. Despa is one adult male teacher with swept-back blond short hair, two small blond moustache tufts, rust-red long coat, white fur collar, beige pants and dark boots. Use fine dark-gray outlines, flat colors, and very light soft shading; no photorealism, 3D, thick paint, advertising lighting, other characters, logos, watermarks, Chinese text, English text, numbers, labels, readable screens, arrows, chart axes, blue circles or unexplained markers. Output a true transparent PNG: every unpainted pixel alpha 0; never render a white or gray checkerboard, floor, room, paper, border, sticker edge, shadow, or halo. White pants and fur collar remain opaque white. Keep every body and prop fully inside a six-percent safe margin.

Additional course-specific guardrails: 沿用固定的波吉与德斯帕、二维深灰细轮廓和平涂画法；除这两位角色外不出现其他人物。 每张均为真实透明PNG，未绘制区域alpha为0；白裤子和白毛领保持不透明白色，不得出现底色、棋盘格、地板、边框、贴纸阴影或水印。 AI图内不出现中文、英文、数字、Logo、品牌、标签、箭头、图表或可读屏幕；详情中文由后续共用排字流程处理。 食物只作为营养概念的简洁道具，不作医疗处方、体重羞辱或夸张前后对比；所有主体留出短边6%安全边距。
